ValidationRule.description: Date Service Confirmation must be today's date. It cannot be in the Past or the Future. For reference, check user story #26355 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (RecordType_Name__c = "CLAS - Shred") && OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Date_Service_Confirmation__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Service_Confirmation__c)) && DATEVALUE(Date_Service_Confirmation__c) != TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Date_Service_Confirmation__c)) || DATEVALUE(Date_Service_Confirmation__c) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Date_Service_Confirmation__c)) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Service_Confirmation__c)) && DATEVALUE(Date_Service_Confirmation__c) != TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Date Service Confirmation must be today's date. It cannot be in the Past or the Future.
